game.title: Pico-Clinic
title.subtitle: The drone micro-surgery workshop
op.hint.unscrew: Put your finger on a screw, then circle around it to unscrew it.
op.hint.rusty: Rusty screw: keep turning a little longer!
op.hint.connector: The connector is unplugged. Drag the plug to its socket.
done.title: Fixed!
op.hint.chip_remove: The chip is fried! Grab it and pull it off the green board.
op.hint.chip_drag_old: Take it off the green board, then let go.
op.hint.chip_place: Take the new chip from the box at the top right and set it on the frame.
op.hint.chip_drag_new: Aim for the frame: let go when it turns bright white.
op.hint.solder: The track is cut. Put your finger on the orange ring, on the iron's handle: the tip stays ahead of your finger.
op.hint.heating: The iron is heating up… hold still!
op.hint.trace: Follow the path to the other pad without lifting your finger.
op.chip_off_board: Take it all the way off the board!
op.chip_miss: Not quite… aim for the frame.
op.too_early: Wait for the iron to heat up!
op.break: Finger lifted: start again from the pad.
op.hint.diag: Diagnosis! Put your finger on the board: a magnifier appears. Move it around to find hidden faults.
op.hint.diag_move: Move the magnifier over the parts of the board.
op.hint.vacuum: The vacuum follows your finger, just above it. Rub quickly and avoid the circled capacitors!
op.hint.rust_left: Still some rust: rub it with your finger to vacuum it, or press Start.
op.fragile_broken: Ouch! Broken capacitor: you'll have to buy a new one.
done.already_paid: Order already paid: replay for 3 stars!
op.hint.rust: Rust (brown spots)! Rub it quickly with your finger: the vacuum appears just above it. Avoid the blue capacitors.
op.hint.cap_remove: A capacitor is broken: the drone won't start. Grab it and take it off the board.
op.hint.cap_place: Take a new capacitor (next to the box) and put it on a blinking spot.
op.hint.cap_drag_new: Drop it on the blinking spot.
op.cap_miss: Not quite… aim for the spot.
op.hint.cap_drag_old: Take it off the green board, then let go.
orders.title: Orders
orders.need_stars: Exam: you need {n} stars (you have {s}). Replay some orders!
shop.title: Shop
tool.laser.desc: Very wide path, burns even more slowly
tool.vacuum_pump.desc: Cleans an area twice as wide
tool.scanner.desc: Shows every fault as soon as you open up
tool.tweezers_fine.desc: Chips and capacitors snap in more easily
done.need_stars: Next order: exam at {n} stars (you have {s})
arc.lea.1.intro: Hello... my drone won't work. Dad says it's too old.
arc.lea.1.thanks: It flies! Thank you so much!
arc.passage.2.intro: My drone spent the winter at the back of the garage. Look at all this rust!
arc.passage.3.intro: My dog chewed a cable. Since then it won't fly at all.
arc.passage.3.thanks: It flies! I'll keep it on a higher shelf, promise.
arc.passage.4.intro: It went "pfff" and a little smoke came out. It smells burnt!
arc.passage.4.thanks: No more burnt smell! It's like magic.
arc.passage.5.intro: It won't start and I can't see anything broken. Can you take a look?
arc.passage.5.thanks: Two hidden faults? Good thing you have a magnifier!
arc.passage.6.intro: My dragonfly fell into a puddle. She creaks when she flaps her wings.
arc.passage.6.thanks: She's twirling! Thank you, thank you!
arc.volute.7.intro: My scarab Auguste, a darling! His wing cases have been dragging for a week.
arc.volute.7.thanks: Auguste is flying! You have fairy fingers. I'll be back, you can count on me.
arc.turbo.8.intro: Ten minutes before the race! Can you do it in five?
arc.turbo.8.thanks: You're the best! I owe you a win.
arc.lea.9.intro: This is Pantoufle. Grandma gave him to me. He doesn't purr anymore.
arc.ampere.10.intro: I... built this. I think. I lost the plans.
arc.ampere.10.thanks: Extraordinary! How did you guess? You remind me of someone.
counter.title: Counter
counter.exam_line: Rank {r} exam, boss! Every star counts here. Even one is enough to pass.
orders.gribouille_stars: To open the exam we need {n} stars, boss. We have {s}. Let's replay old orders to earn the missing ones!
nb.title: Master Ohm's notebook
nb.parts_hint: Never sold: they must be earned.
nb.use.proto: Needed for the prototype of order {n}
rank.1.unlocks: Simple toy drones, screwdriver and basic iron
rank.2.unlocks: Cyber insects, strong vacuum, precision iron, Pantoufle
rank.3.unlocks: Mechanical mascots, thermal magnifier, fine tweezers
rank.4.unlocks: Pro and race drones, laser, magnetic pump, antistatic tweezers
client.lea.bio: A shy little girl. Her robot plush Pantoufle was made by her grandmother.
client.volute.bio: A chatty collector of mechanical insects. She names every one of them and is preparing a big exhibition.
client.turbo.bio: A drone racer, hasty and boastful, but a good loser. His rival is called Zephyr.
client.ampere.bio: An absent-minded inventor who always loses his plans. He seems to have known Master Ohm...
client.brindille.bio: An overworked neighborhood courier. His little drone fleet breaks down every week.
client.quartz.bio: The serious, demanding director of a large robot clinic.
rankup.title: New rank!
rankup.gribouille: Well done, boss! The workshop is growing. Master Ohm would be proud.
op.hint.lift: No more screws! Slide the cover upward to remove it.
gribouille.hint1: Draw a circle around the screw.
tuto.o01: Our very first client! Don't worry, boss: I'll show you everything.
tuto.o08: With Turbo, every second counts: finish before the target time for a big tip!
tuto.open: Tap the drone to put it under the lamp.
tuto.click: Click! The screw is out. Nice job!
tuto.screws: Now do the same with the other three screws.
tuto.cover: No more screws! Slide the cover upward.
tuto.connector: See the blinking plug? Slide it into its socket.
tuto.start: All fixed! Press Start to close it up.
tuto.lever: The magic moment: pull the lever down!
tuto.stars: Three stars to earn: it works, it's clean, and your repair is precise.
tuto.credits: The client pays you in credits. If you're quick, they add a tip!
tuto.shop: Credits buy better tools. Let's go see the shop!
tuto.shop_here: This is Master Ohm's shop. Every tool has three levels.
tuto.shop_here2: A better iron, a stronger lens... Come back when you have credits. Back to work!
tuto.rusty: This screw is rusty: you'll have to turn longer. Keep going!
tuto.vacuum: Rust! Rub over it quickly: the vacuum follows your finger, just above it.
tuto.vacuum2: Keep going! Avoid the blue capacitors, they're fragile.
tuto.solder: A cut trace! Grab the iron by the orange ring, wait for it to heat, then follow the trace.
tuto.chip_out: Something smells burnt! Grab the smoking chip and pull it off the green board.
tuto.chip_in: Now take a new chip from the box and set it in the frame.
tuto.diag: Can't see anything? Keep your finger down: a magnifier appears. Move it over the board.
tuto.diag2: Slowly... Stop on each part to look at it closely.
tuto.diag_done: Found it! Hidden faults don't stand a chance against you.
tuto.curve: A trace with a bend! Follow the curve carefully, no rushing.
chapter.1.title: The Inheritance
chapter.1.sub: The first clients of Master Ohm's workshop
chapter.2.title: The Workshop Grows
chapter.2.sub: Turbo comes back, Mr. Brindille arrives
story.ch1.1: Oh! Hello! Sorry, I didn't hear you come in. I'm Gribouille.
story.ch1.2: Welcome to Master Ohm's workshop, the best drone repairer in the neighborhood.
story.ch1.3: He left one morning without a word. He left his tools, me... and a key with your name on it.
story.ch1.4: So, boss, shall we reopen the workshop? Look, here's someone already!
story.nb.1: Boss! Look what I found stuck under the workbench: Master Ohm's notebook!
story.nb.2: He wrote everything in it: his clients, his ranks, the rare parts he collected.
story.nb.3: Now it's your notebook. You'll find it next to the shop, in the order list.
story.nb.page: A good repairer listens to the machine before touching it. — O.
story.ch2.1: Boss, did you see? The whole neighborhood is talking about the workshop!
story.ch2.2: Turbo swears he'll never race again without stopping by. He says you're his lucky charm.
story.ch2.3: And a courier, Mr. Brindille, left three messages this morning. His fleet is worn out.
story.ch2.4: New patients are coming too: dragonflies, beetles, plushies... This is going to be a workout!
arc.brindille.11.intro: Another courier out of service. The round won't wait!
arc.brindille.11.thanks: Perfect. See you next week! Well, I hope not.
arc.passage.12.intro: My dragonfly has been flying in circles since this morning. She looks dizzy.
arc.passage.12.thanks: She's flying straight! Well, straight for a dragonfly.
arc.passage.13.intro: My beetle goes clack-clack when it walks. My cat won't go near it.
arc.passage.13.thanks: No more clack-clack! The cat is relieved, and so am I.
arc.brindille.14.intro: My drone keeps delivering next to the mailbox. It's out of tune, isn't it?
arc.brindille.14.thanks: It aims true now! My neighbor will finally get her parcels.
arc.turbo.15.intro: Qualifiers tomorrow. Zephyr brags that he has the fastest drone in town.
arc.turbo.15.thanks: It's faster than before! Zephyr had better watch out.
arc.volute.16.intro: My dragonfly Cleo has lost her sparkle. I found her in Lisbon in 1998, imagine!
arc.volute.16.thanks: There she shines! I'll tell all my friends.
arc.passage.17.intro: It's my son's plush toy. It went for a spin in the washing machine...
arc.passage.17.thanks: All clean and working again! My son will jump for joy.
arc.lea.18.intro: Pantoufle got cold by the window yesterday. He's making a funny noise.
arc.lea.18.thanks: No more noise! I gave him a scarf.
arc.brindille.19.intro: It swelled up all at once, like a balloon. I thought I'd bring it before it blew.
arc.brindille.19.thanks: Phew, no explosion! I'll buy you a coffee... some other day.
arc.passage.20.intro: I found it in the attic, all rusty. It was my grandfather's beetle.
arc.passage.20.thanks: Good as new! Grandpa would be proud of him.
arc.ampere.21.intro: My drone doesn't fly straight anymore. There was a plan somewhere, in another pocket.
arc.ampere.21.thanks: It flies straight! A man used to do the same, with those same moves.
arc.volute.22.intro: My two jewels, Cleo and Auguste, before my exhibition. Everything must be perfect.
arc.volute.22.thanks: Perfect! You are officially the repairer of my collection.
back.title: Leave this repair?
back.text: The patient goes back to the order list. What you've already fixed will be lost.
bench.title: Test bench
bench.sub: Pick a gesture to try. Nothing is paid or saved.
sec.tap.battery: The battery is all swollen! Tap it for a closer look.
sec.tap.heart: The heart battery is flat. Tap it for a closer look.
sec.tap.gear: A gear is stuck. Tap it for a closer look.
sec.tap.sensor: The sensor is off. Tap it to tune it.
sec.tap.pins: Some pins are bent. Tap them for a closer look.
sec.tap.spring: The spring is all floppy. Tap it for a closer look.
sec.tap.batteries: The batteries are flat. Tap them for a closer look.
sec.tap.oxide: A circuit is oxidized (blue-green spots). Tap it for a closer look.
sec.battery.out_hint: Slowly slide the battery to the right without touching the red edges.
sec.battery.slow: Easy! Too fast and it heats up.
sec.battery.hot: It's heating up! (−{n} cleanliness) More gently.
sec.gear.debris: Some debris is jamming the gear! Slide it out of the red circle.
sec.gear.place: Put the gear on its axle (the blinking circle).
sec.gear.turn: Turn it around the axle: the white mark must point at the orange triangle, then let go.
sec.gear.turn_help: Let go when the white mark is in the green zone.
sec.gear.miss: The teeth don't catch… aim for the triangle.
sec.sensor: Slide both knobs: the signal calms down as you get close to the right setting.
sec.pins: Push the tip of each bent pin until it stands straight.
sec.pins.drag: Let go when it's straight (green zone).
sec.spring: Circle your finger around the spring at a steady speed: 3 turns.
sec.batteries: Slide the two new batteries (on the left) onto the old ones.
sec.batteries.drag: Drop it on an old battery.
sec.batteries.miss: Not quite… aim for the holder.
sec.batteries.panel: Rub the solar panel quickly with your finger to wipe off the dust.
sec.oxide: The brush follows your finger, just above it. Rub the blue-green spots without touching the little parts: on the 3rd touch, they crack.
sec.oxide.hit: Ouch! −{n} cleanliness. {left} more touch(es) and it cracks.
tuto.sec.battery: Whoa, this battery is all swollen! Tap it for a closer look.
tuto.sec.battery2: Slide it out gently along the rail. Too fast and it heats up! And avoid the red edges.
tuto.sec.heart: This plush's heart is very weak. Tap it, we'll recharge it.
tuto.sec.heart2: First, open the zipper by following the dotted line.
tuto.sec.gear: A gear is stuck! Tap it for a closer look.
tuto.sec.gear2: First, get the debris out of the circle. Then the gear on its axle, and a quarter turn!
tuto.sec.sensor: The sensor is off. Tap it to open it.
tuto.sec.sensor2: Move the knobs and listen: the sound rises and the signal calms down as you get warmer!
tuto.sec.pins: Bent pins! Tap them for a closer look.
tuto.sec.pins2: Push the tip of each pin with a little flick until it stands straight.
tuto.sec.spring: This spring is all floppy. Tap it, we'll wind it up.
tuto.sec.spring2: Circle around it, not too fast, like winding a watch: three turns!
tuto.sec.batteries: The batteries are flat. Tap them for a closer look.
tuto.sec.batteries2: Slide the new batteries onto the old ones, then rub the solar panel.
tuto.sec.oxide: Blue-green spots: the circuit is oxidized. Tap it for a closer look.
tuto.sec.oxide2: Precision work: the brush is just above your finger. Avoid the little parts: on the 3rd touch, they crack!
bench.not_saved: Test bench: nothing is paid or saved.
sec.battery.drop: Put the old battery on the rack, in the red slot at the top.
sec.battery.take: Take the new battery (green slot, at the bottom) and bring it to the rail entrance.
sec.battery.insert: Push it all the way in, gently and right between the red edges.
tuto.sec.battery3: Well done! Put it on the rack on the right, in the red slot.
tuto.sec.battery4: Now the new one: bring it to the rail entrance and push it in very gently, right in the middle.
sec.heart.open: Open the zipper: slide the pull along the dotted line.
sec.heart.opened: There it is! It's beating very faintly…
sec.heart.beat: Tap the heart right when the circle reaches it, on every beat.
sec.heart.listen: Wait for the circle to reach the heart…
sec.heart.miss: Off the beat… wait for the circle.
sec.heart.close: Close the zipper: bring the pull back to the left.
tuto.sec.heart3: Tap it in time with its beats, when the circle reaches it. Not too fast: it's fragile!
sec.oxide.broken: Part cracked! It will have to be replaced (−{n} credits).
tuto.sec.heart4: Perfect! Close the zipper to keep it nice and warm.
sec.oxide.replace: A part is cracked: touch it and drag it into the grey bin, bottom left.
sec.oxide.to_bin: Drag it into the grey bin, bottom left.
sec.oxide.binned: Binned! Take a new part, bottom right.
sec.oxide.place: Put the new part on the blinking spot.
sec.oxide.miss: Not quite… aim for the spot.
tuto.sec.oxide3: Oops, a cracked part! Bin it and put in a new one. It costs a few credits.
chapter.3.title: Insects and mascots
chapter.4.title: The big clinic
chapter.5.title: The Master
arc.passage.23.intro: My firefly lantern barely glows. It used to light my bedtime reading.
arc.passage.23.thanks: It glows like the first day! Now I can finish my novel.
arc.brindille.24.intro: This one won't start, and I can't even see why.
arc.brindille.24.thanks: You have a keen eye! I would have just shaken it.
arc.passage.25.intro: My spring rabbit won't hop anymore. It just sits there looking sad.
arc.passage.25.thanks: Boing, boing! It's hopping everywhere! Thank you!
arc.turbo.26.intro: My sensor sees turns that don't exist. Zephyr is laughing at me.
arc.turbo.26.thanks: It hugs the track! Zephyr is going to make a funny face.
arc.passage.27.intro: My bee forages the wrong side of the garden and squeaks while flying.
arc.passage.27.thanks: She heads straight for the roses, without a sound. Perfect!
arc.lea.28.intro: Pantoufle's heart is very weak. He doesn't want to play anymore.
arc.lea.28.thanks: There's a word written inside his heart... Grandma wrote it!
arc.passage.29.intro: My wind-up cat stops after three steps. It looks like it's sulking.
arc.passage.29.thanks: It walks around the living room without stopping! It even purrs.
arc.ampere.30.intro: My flying jellyfish floats sideways. I put a lens in it somewhere... or not.
arc.ampere.30.thanks: It dances in the air! That crystal lens... Master Ohm had one just like it.
arc.passage.31.intro: My firefly blinks randomly. The wires are cut in three places.
arc.passage.31.thanks: It blinks in rhythm! Like a tiny star.
arc.volute.32.intro: This is Melissa, my bee. She spent some time in the shed, poor thing.
arc.volute.32.thanks: Melissa is buzzing again! She'll be the queen of my exhibition.
arc.brindille.33.intro: Two broken on the same day! They must have planned it.
arc.brindille.33.thanks: Both are back on the road. You're my hero of the week!
arc.turbo.34.intro: My real racing drone. Qualifiers are tonight. Not a second to lose!
arc.turbo.34.thanks: Qualified! And ahead of Zephyr! I owe you big time.
arc.quartz.35.intro: I've heard about your workshop. Let's see what you can do with this camera drone.
arc.quartz.35.thanks: Good. Very good, actually. We'll meet again.
arc.passage.36.intro: My praying mantis can't fold its legs. It looks like it's praying crooked.
arc.passage.36.thanks: She folds her legs so elegantly. What poise!
arc.volute.37.intro: Glimmer, my firefly, lost its glow just before the exhibition rehearsal.
arc.volute.37.thanks: Glimmer lights up the whole display! You're an artist.
arc.passage.38.intro: My music bear plays off-key and ends its song with a squeak.
arc.passage.38.thanks: The lullaby is perfect. I think I'll fall asleep right here.
arc.turbo.39.intro: Semi-final tomorrow! I pushed it a little hard in practice...
arc.turbo.39.thanks: It's even faster than before. Final, here I come!
arc.ampere.40.intro: A paper bird that flies by itself. Well, it used to. It needs a special spring.
arc.ampere.40.thanks: It glides! That old watch spring... Just like in my friend's workshop.
arc.passage.41.intro: My solar hedgehog won't wake up anymore, even in full sun.
arc.passage.41.thanks: It's taking its little walk in the sun. Thank you so much!
arc.brindille.42.intro: Three at once! The whole neighborhood round is stuck. Help!
arc.brindille.42.thanks: The whole fleet is flying! The neighborhood will get its parcels on time.
arc.quartz.43.intro: A mantis from my clinic. My teams couldn't find the fault.
arc.quartz.43.thanks: You found what they missed. I'm taking note.
arc.passage.44.intro: My music bear's belly swelled up and it sings backwards.
arc.passage.44.thanks: It sings in tune and its belly is flat again. Bravo!
arc.lea.45.intro: Pantoufle is fine, but Grandma says he needs a check-up.
arc.lea.45.thanks: He's all clean! Here, this is for you: Grandma's tiny key.
arc.quartz.46.intro: My clinic's prototype. Repair it, and we'll talk about a partnership.
arc.quartz.46.thanks: Flawless. Here is a cut quartz stone: the symbol of our agreement.
arc.passage.47.intro: My mantis has it all: bent legs, crazy sensor, cut wires. A real collection!
arc.passage.47.thanks: Everything works! You really are the Master Micro-Surgeon.
arc.volute.48.intro: The exhibition opens tomorrow! Cleo, Auguste and Glimmer must be perfect.
arc.volute.48.thanks: A triumphant exhibition! Please accept this glass butterfly, my finest treasure.
arc.turbo.49.intro: The final! First heat in an hour. We don't give up!
arc.turbo.49.thanks: First heat won! Zephyr can't believe it.
arc.ampere.50.intro: A dream box. It needs a silver tuning fork and a gold wire. I think.
arc.ampere.50.thanks: It plays the music of dreams... That was Master Ohm's idea, you know.
arc.passage.51.intro: My solar hedgehog is green with rust and won't move.
arc.passage.51.thanks: It shines like a new penny! Thank you for him.
arc.brindille.52.intro: Total breakdown! All three fell at the same time. I don't get it.
arc.brindille.52.thanks: You saved my round... and my job. Thank you, truly.
arc.quartz.53.intro: One last test before we sign our partnership: this music bear.
arc.quartz.53.thanks: Partnership signed. My clinic will send you its hardest cases.
arc.lea.54.intro: Grandma came with me! Pantoufle is just a little tired.
arc.lea.54.thanks: Grandma says thank you, and so do I. Pantoufle purrs like never before!
arc.ampere.55.intro: My clock turtle is three hours late. It needs a brass gear.
arc.ampere.55.thanks: It's on time, to the second! Master Ohm would have loved it.
arc.turbo.56.intro: Last heat! If we beat the record, the title is ours!
arc.turbo.56.thanks: Record broken! Champion! And Zephyr shook my hand.
arc.volute.57.intro: Part two of the exhibition: Melissa and my new mantis, Celeste.
arc.volute.57.thanks: The crowd is cheering! My exhibition is the finest in town.
arc.quartz.58.intro: The honeycomb, our joint project. It will only work with the quartz stone.
arc.quartz.58.thanks: It's buzzing with energy. We did fine work together.
arc.ampere.59.intro: I found this drone in my attic. It's one of Master Ohm's samples. There's a letter...
arc.ampere.59.thanks: There was a golden chip inside... and the letter is for you. Read it.
arc.ohm.60.intro: If you are reading this, you are ready. Here is my last prototype. Repair it, take your time.
arc.ohm.60.thanks: It flies. The workshop is yours, Master Micro-Surgeon. Keep this medallion. — Ohm
op.solder_next: Piece soldered ({p}%)! One more: track {i} of {n}.
op.hint.solder_n: The track is cut into {n} pieces: solder piece {i}. Put your finger on the orange circle on the handle.
orders.gribouille_part: This prototype needs: {part}. We get it with 3 stars on order {n}. Let's replay it, boss!
orders.gribouille_gift: This prototype needs: {part}. A client will give it to us at order {n}.
free.title: Free workshop
free.sub: Random patients, at the rank you choose. 50% earnings, no rare parts, and stars don't count toward ranks.
free.sub_test: Test free workshop: every rank is open, nothing is paid or saved.
free.note: Free workshop: 50% earnings, stars not counted.
bench.sub_orders: Play any order (orange: exams). Nothing is paid or saved.
